subject: Brightline pilot: extension request and slab discount / proposal
messages:
From: Carlos Mendez <carlos.m@brightline.ai>
To: tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Emma Li <emma@brightline.ai>
Date: Thu, 3 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick: pilot extension and discount ask

Hi Tessa —

We’ve been running through the pilot this week and the team flagged two things: first, we need another 2–3 weeks to finish our edge-case tests; second, the execs asked whether you can provide a short-term slab discount for the extra capacity we’ll consume during that period (we expect a 35–40% spike in tokens for the next 10 business days).

Can you outline what an extension + one-off discount would look like? We’re trying to avoid restarting procurement but we also need clear numbers to show leadership.

Thanks — Carlos
Senior ML Ops, Brightline AI

Attachment: sample-output-issues.txt (txt)
From: tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Carlos Mendez <carlos.m@brightline.ai>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Emma Li <emma@brightline.ai>
Date: Thu, 3 Jul 2025 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick: pilot extension and discount ask

Carlos — thanks for the heads up, totally doable. Two pragmatic options to keep procurement simple:

1) Short extension + usage slab: add 14 days to the pilot window and apply a one-time slab discount of 25% on overage tokens during that extension period. No change to the current SOW aside from dates and the discount line.

2) Credit cushion: add 3,000 credits (pre-purchased) to the pilot at a 15% discount; Brightline consumes credits during the extended run and any excess converts at standard rates.

I’ve attached a quick SOW revision that shows option 1 with dates and the discount line (Redwood_SOW_Brightline_v1.3.pdf). I’m looping Ben for pricing confirmation and Monica for approval on a one-time concession. If you prefer, we can also do a timebox extension (2 weeks) + staged milestone acceptance to trigger the discount.

Which would you prefer so I can pull approvals and update the doc?

—Tessa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: Redwood_SOW_Brightline_v1.3.pdf (pdf); usage-breakdown-forecast.csv (csv)
From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 3 Jul 2025 12:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick: pilot extension and discount ask

Tessa — copied. I ran the numbers against their forecast. If we do option 1 (14-day extension + slab), a 25% one-time discount on overage tokens keeps unit economics intact up to ~$18k additional spend. If they push to 30% we start to erosion on the margin unless we set a hard cap ($20k). Option 2 (credits) is safer for us but less attractive to procurement (they prefer a straight %).

Recommendation: approve 25% slab + milestone acceptance at day 7 to validate progress; include a hard cap clause: discount applies to overage up to $20k then normal rates.

I’ll need Monica to sign off on the cap and one-time concession language.

—Ben
Director, Sales Engineering
From: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 3 Jul 2025 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick: pilot extension and discount ask

Approving 25% one-time slab discount with the $20k cap and a mid-extension milestone (day 7) for acceptance checks. Please add the following line to the SOW: "One-time overage discount of 25% applies to usage consumed during the extension period up to a maximum discounted amount of $20,000. Beyond the cap, standard published rates apply."

Also include: Brightline must confirm scope of edge-case tests in writing before extension start. No recurring precedent (one-off only).

Monica
VP, Sales Operations
From: tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Carlos Mendez <carlos.m@brightline.ai>, Emma Li <emma@brightline.ai>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 4 Jul 2025 02:45:00 +0000
Subject: Formal: Brightline pilot extension & one-time slab discount (SOW revision attached)

Carlos / Emma — thanks for the quick response this morning. Per our internal approvals we can offer the following formal proposal: 

Proposal summary:
- Extension: add 14 calendar days to the current pilot window (new end date: 2025-07-20).
- One-time slab discount: 25% discount applies to overage tokens consumed during the extension period, applied up to a maximum discounted amount of $20,000.
- Milestone: mid-extension checkpoint on 2025-07-14; Brightline provides test acceptance notes and we review performance regressions and infra stability. Discount only applies if the acceptance checkpoint is completed.
- Procurement: no new PO required; this is an amendment to the existing SOW (attached).

Next steps (please reply):
1) Confirm you want the 14-day option and acceptance milestone.
2) Confirm the list of edge-case tests (one-paragraph) so we capture scope in the amendment.
3) If approved, we’ll countersign the SOW revision and activate the extension within 48 hours.

If you’d rather take the credit cushion alternative (3,000 credits at 15% discount) say so and we’ll send that version.

—Tessa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment: Redwood_SOW_Brightline_v1.3.pdf (pdf)
